instruction: Make a plasma ray effect that tweens its width to zero and cleans up.
output:
local TweenService = game:GetService('TweenService')
local Debris = game:GetService('Debris')

local function plasmaBeam(originAttachment, targetPosition, duration)
    local endPart = Instance.new('Part')
    endPart.Anchored = true
    endPart.CanCollide = false
    endPart.CanQuery = false
    endPart.CanTouch = false
    endPart.Transparency = 1
    endPart.Size = Vector3.one * 0.2
    endPart.Position = targetPosition
    endPart.Parent = workspace

    local endAttachment = Instance.new('Attachment')
    endAttachment.Parent = endPart

    local beam = Instance.new('Beam')
    beam.Attachment0 = originAttachment
    beam.Attachment1 = endAttachment
    beam.Width0 = 2
    beam.Width1 = 2
    beam.LightEmission = 1.0
    beam.LightInfluence = 0
    beam.FaceCamera = true
    beam.Segments = 12
    beam.CurveSize0 = 0
    beam.CurveSize1 = 0
    beam.Color = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 255)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 200)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(100, 0, 120)),
    })
    beam.Parent = endPart

    duration = duration or 0.4
    TweenService:Create(beam, TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
        Width0 = 0,
        Width1 = 0,
    }):Play()
    Debris:AddItem(endPart, duration + 0.1)
end

return plasmaBeam

    local ring = Instance.new('Part')

        Transparency = 1,
    }):Play()
    Debris:AddItem(ring, duration + 0.1)
end

return natureShockwave

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
local TweenService = game:GetService('TweenService')
local Debris = game:GetService('Debris')

local shakeEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild('CameraShakeEvent')  -- BindableEvent listened to by the client camera script

local function natureExplosion(position, radius)
    local anchor = Instance.new('Part')
    anchor.Anchored = true
    anchor.CanCollide = false
    anchor.CanQuery = false
    anchor.CanTouch = false
    anchor.Transparency = 1
    anchor.Size = Vector3.one
    anchor.Position = position
    anchor.Parent = workspace

    -- light flash
    local light = Instance.new('PointLight')
    light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 200, 60)
    light.Range = radius * 1.6
    light.Brightness = 8
    light.Shadows = false
    light.Parent = anchor
    TweenService:Create(light, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Brightness = 0}):Play()

    -- particle burst
    local emitter = Instance.new('ParticleEmitter')
    emitter.Texture = 'rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds'
    emitter.LightEmission = 0.4
    emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(220, 255, 160)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.4, Color3.fromRGB(80, 200, 60)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(20, 90, 20)),
    })
    emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new({
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, radius * 0.25),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
    })
    emitter.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
    })
    emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.4, 0.9)
    emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(radius * 1.2, radius * 3)
    emitter.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
    emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
    emitter.Drag = 3
    emitter.Enabled = false
    emitter.Parent = anchor
    emitter:Emit(math.floor(radius * 3))

    -- expanding ring
    local ring = Instance.new('Part')
    ring.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
    ring.Anchored = true
    ring.CanCollide = false
    ring.CanQuery = false
    ring.CanTouch = false
    ring.Material = Enum.Material.Grass
    ring.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 200, 60)
    ring.Size = Vector3.new(0.3, 2, 2)
    ring.CFrame = CFrame.new(position) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
    ring.Parent = workspace
    TweenService:Create(ring, TweenInfo.new(0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
        Size = Vector3.new(0.3, radius * 2, radius * 2),
        Transparency = 1,
    }):Play()

    shakeEvent:Fire(radius * 0.4, 0.5)  -- intensity, duration

    Debris:AddItem(ring, 0.6)
    Debris:AddItem(anchor, 1.5)
end

return natureExplosion
